name: kaiki/kaiki
description: Kaiki — booking engine for cruises, day trips and private charters.

dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1 --timeout=0" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "npm run dev" --names=server,queue,logs,vite --kill-others

scripts-descriptions.setup: Clean checkout to a running app: .env, key, SQLite file, migrate, seed, build assets.
scripts-descriptions.dev: artisan serve + queue listener + Vite together.
scripts-descriptions.test: Pest, excluding the mysql, chromium and external groups (ENV-15). The flag is repeated deliberately: Pest ignores a comma-separated --exclude-group.
scripts-descriptions.test:fast: The fast group only. Used by the Stop hook.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: The TST-1 gate: coverage of app/Domain only, failing under 80%. Needs PCOV, so CI only (ENV-22). The threshold lives here and nowhere else.
scripts-descriptions.schema:snapshot: Regenerates database/schema/mysql-schema.snapshot.sql, the file the migrate-from-zero gate compares against (ENV-10). Needs a MySQL 8 connection - see docs/ci.md.
scripts-descriptions.test:mysql: The mysql group. Needs a MySQL 8 instance; normally CI only.
scripts-descriptions.api:docs: Regenerates build/openapi.generated.json from the routes, the file the api-docs-drift gate compares against docs/api.md §5 (ENV-28). The refresh path is this one command; docs/api.md is never regenerated from the code.
scripts-descriptions.test:api-docs: The ENV-28 gate: reconciles the routes and the generated OpenAPI document against the contract in docs/api.md §5. A required CI check.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:check: The I18N-2 and I18N-3 gates: EL/EN key parity, and no hardcoded user-facing string. A required CI check. The allow-list for both lives in tests/Support/I18n/allow-list.php.
scripts-descriptions.lint:test: Pint in check mode. What CI runs.
scripts-descriptions.ci: lint:test, analyse, test - in that order, failing on the first.
scripts-descriptions.test:tenancy: The cross-tenant isolation gate. A required CI check in its own right (ADR-0001).
scripts-descriptions.test:widget-compat: ADR-0011's third release gate: the widget's expectations of /api/v1, read out of its own TypeScript interfaces. The widget-release workflow will not repoint the alias without it.
